title: Relationship among ℕ, W, ℤ and ℚ
competency: Describe the relationship among the sets ℕ, W, ℤ and ℚ.

keywords.def: An item in a set. We write ∈ for "is an element of".
A drawing of circles that shows how sets are related.

en.text: Natural numbers sit inside the whole numbers. Whole numbers sit inside the integers. Integers sit inside the rational numbers. So a natural number like 10 is also whole, an integer and rational. A fraction like 1/7 is only rational.

am.text: የተፈጥሮ ቁጥሮች በሙሉ ቁጥሮች ውስጥ ናቸው። ሙሉ ቁጥሮች በኢንቲጀሮች ውስጥ ናቸው። ኢንቲጀሮች በሬሽናል ቁጥሮች ውስጥ ናቸው። ስለዚህ 10 ሙሉ፣ ኢንቲጀርና ሬሽናል ነው። 1/7 ግን ሬሽናል ብቻ ነው።

screens.title: Guess the smallest set
screens.text: Put each number in the smallest set it belongs to. Check against the figure after.
items: A fraction that is not an integer.

screens.title: Recall
paras: A collection of items is called a set.
The items in a set are called elements. We use the sign ∈.
A Venn diagram uses circles to show how sets are related.

screens.title: Each set sits inside the next
screens.ask: Tap a circle, then tap each number.
rings: Any a/b with a, b integers and b ≠ 0.
numbers: A natural number is in every set.
A fraction that is not an integer.

screens.title: Classifying a number
paras: When a set is inside a larger set, its numbers belong to the larger set too.
To classify a number, find its smallest set. It also belongs to every set around it.

screens.title: Key words
defs: An item in a set, shown with ∈.
A drawing of circles that shows how sets are related.

screens.text: Can a number be rational and whole, but not an integer?
screens.why: Every whole number is an integer.
screens.clue: Look at Figure 1.11. Where is the W circle?

screens.title: Classify
items: A natural number is in every set.
screens.why: Find the smallest set, then add every set around it.
screens.clue: Is the number a fraction? Is it negative?

screens.text: Solomon says 0 belongs only to the rational numbers. What is his error?
opts: 0 is also whole and an integer
screens.ans: 0 is also whole and an integer

screens.text: Every natural number is a whole number.
The number −3 2/7 belongs to the negative integers.
screens.why: −3 2/7 has a fraction part, so it is not an integer. It is a negative rational number.

items.text: Solomon says 0 belongs only to ℚ. Which is correct?
opts: 0 belongs to W, ℤ and ℚ
items.ans: 0 belongs to W, ℤ and ℚ
items.why: 0 is whole, so it is also an integer and rational.

items.text: The whole numbers and their opposites are called integers.
items.why: That is the meaning of integers.

items.text: Every natural number is a whole number.
The number −3 2/7 belongs to the negative integers.
items.why: It has a fraction part, so it is rational, not an integer.

test.text: What is the smallest set that contains −7?
What is the smallest set that contains 2/3?
Every integer is a rational number.
